Definition: from G2080; from inside; also used as equivalent to G2080 (inside):--inward(-ly), (from) within, without.
BiblicalUsage: Esṓthen means from within — out of the inside, the source inside a person. Evil thoughts proceed from within, Jesus says, out of the heart; and the Pharisees clean the outside of the cup while the inside is full of extortion. It is the word for where sin actually lives.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe esṓthen is the word for honesty about sin: it comes from within, not from outside. I hold that cleaning the outside while the inside stays filthy is the Pharisees' mistake, and I do not want to make it.
